name: Horizon Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Horizon Securities Co., Ltd. operates as a key provider of financial services within Taiwan's securities market. Its comprehensive suite of offerings encompasses international securities trading, underwriting, and share registry management. Beyond these core functions, the firm also facilitates leveraged trading through margin purchase and short sale services, engages in futures brokerage, conducts proprietary trading, and delivers financial consulting. Established in 1961, Horizon Securities is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
